data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open Experience menu, click Baggage allowance, select cabin class) with cabin class as the parameter, and only adds a harmless read step. It is slightly vague about how the cabin class is selected (a tab versus a link), but a browser automation could still be built from it.
